# CodedDesign for agents

Cartoon React design system. Package: @kenselasie/codeddesign 0.1.4
Catalog: this repo. Public npm. Do not use GitHub Packages.

## Install

npm install @kenselasie/codeddesign

Peers: react@^19, react-dom@^19, @stylexjs/stylex@0.19.1

## Skill

Same SKILL.md for every coding agent (Cursor, Claude, Codex, and others). Copy it into codeddesign/SKILL.md under the agent's skills folder:

- .agents/skills/codeddesign/
- .cursor/skills/codeddesign/
- .claude/skills/codeddesign/
- .codex/skills/codeddesign/

## First render

```tsx
import "@kenselasie/codeddesign/styles.css";
import { Button } from "@kenselasie/codeddesign";
```

The consuming app does not need the StyleX compiler to render components.

## Theme

```tsx
import * as stylex from "@stylexjs/stylex";
import { darkTheme, palettes } from "@kenselasie/codeddesign/theme";

<div {...stylex.props(darkTheme)}>
  {children}
</div>

<div {...stylex.props(palettes.nord.light)}>
  {children}
</div>

import { markerPalettes, markerType, markerRadii, markerShadows } from "@kenselasie/codeddesign/theme";

<div {...stylex.props(markerPalettes.highlighter.light, markerType, markerRadii, markerShadows)}>
  {children}
</div>
```

Worlds: codedcartoony, codedmarker.
CodedCartoony palettes: paper, nord, solarized, catppuccin.
CodedMarker palettes: highlighter, magenta, cyan, amber. Each palette has light and dark.
Fonts: Fredoka in codedcartoony; Archivo 900 in codedmarker; Nunito in codedcartoony; Archivo in codedmarker.
Ink #2a2438 on paper #fff7ef. Radii: s 10px, m 16px, l 22px, pill.
Space: xxs 4, xs 8, s 12, m 16, l 24, xl 32, xxl 48. Shadows: codedcartoony: offset + blur (s1–s4). codedmarker: hard ink offset, no blur..
Color roles: background, white, black, steel, concrete, blue, blueLight, blueDark, whale, whaleLight, whaleDark, smoke, smokeDark, smokeDarker, snow, snowDark, snowDarker, success, danger, dangerDark, warning, warningDark, green, greenLight, greenDark, turquoise, turquoiseLight, turquoiseDark, pink, pinkLight, pinkDark, onAccent, onPastel, well, onWell.
Icon names: check, x, search, info, alert, chevron, chevronLeft, chevronRight, plus, minus, copy, calendar, paperclip, file, image, more, menu, terminal, globe, message, user, settings, home, checkCircle, xCircle, upload, download, arrowUpRight, branch, spark, grip.

## Rules

- Import styles.css once at the app root so Fredoka, Nunito, Archivo, and tokens land.
- Import components from @kenselasie/codeddesign. Do not copy source files into the app.
- Pick one world. codedcartoony is Fredoka, Nunito, and plush offset+blur shadows. codedmarker is Archivo, hard ink shadows, and lime, magenta, cyan, and yellow blocks. Do not mix them or restyle toward shadcn/ui or Ant Design.
- The consuming app does not need the StyleX compiler to render components.
- Theme with stylex.props from @kenselasie/codeddesign/theme. codedcartoony palettes are paper, nord, solarized, and catppuccin. codedmarker palettes are highlighter, magenta, cyan, and amber; apply one with markerType, markerRadii, and markerShadows.
- Prefer an existing component over custom HTML for buttons, fields, dialogs, tables, and chat.
- Do not nest interactive controls inside links.
- Do not nest Card, Form, or MessageScroller inside another card.
- SearchInput is fluid. In a sidebar or toolbar use hideLabel and shape="pill".
- Each export has a catalog page at /components/{id} with live display, recipe, and props. Compose from the package, not from scraping that page.
- Do not invent APIs. If a prop is unknown, omit it or read flattenReference() / package types.

## Machine index

```ts
import {
  agentGuide,
  recipes,
  components,
  reference,
  flattenReference,
  toLlmsTxt,
  agentPrompt,
} from "@kenselasie/codeddesign/agent";
```

## Recipes (copy these)

### Sign-in

Email sign-in with a primary submit.

```tsx
import { Form, TextField, Button, FormActions } from "@kenselasie/codeddesign";

<Form title="Sign in" description="Use the workspace email you were invited with.">
  <TextField label="Work email" type="email" name="email" />
  <FormActions>
    <Button variant="primary">Sign in</Button>
  </FormActions>
</Form>
```

### Data table

Sortable rows of string records.

```tsx
import { DataTable } from "@kenselasie/codeddesign";

<DataTable
  rows={studios}
  columns={[
    { key: "name", header: "Name" },
    { key: "owner", header: "Owner" },
  ]}
/>
```

### Chat

Assistant and user messages in a scroller.

```tsx
import { Message, MessageScroller } from "@kenselasie/codeddesign";

<MessageScroller>
  <Message from="assistant" name="CodedDesign">
    How can I help you today?
  </Message>
  <Message from="user" name="Ada">
    Show me a savings dashboard.
  </Message>
</MessageScroller>
```

### Empty

A screen with nothing to show yet.

```tsx
import { EmptyState, Button } from "@kenselasie/codeddesign";

<EmptyState
  title="Nothing matches"
  description="Try another filter."
  action={<Button variant="primary">Clear filters</Button>}
/>
```

### Saved

Inline success or warning after an action.

```tsx
import { Alert } from "@kenselasie/codeddesign";

<Alert variant="success" title="Workspace saved">
  North studio is up to date.
</Alert>
```

### Settings tabs

Switch panels in a settings or account screen.

```tsx
import { Tabs, TabList, Tab, TabPanel, Body } from "@kenselasie/codeddesign";

<Tabs defaultValue="account">
  <TabList>
    <Tab value="account">Account</Tab>
    <Tab value="billing">Billing</Tab>
  </TabList>
  <TabPanel value="account">
    <Body>Profile, password, and sessions.</Body>
  </TabPanel>
  <TabPanel value="billing">
    <Body>Invoices and payment methods.</Body>
  </TabPanel>
</Tabs>
```

## Components

### General

#### Button
Import: `Button`
Use: Actions. Primary for the one next step.
Live: /components/button
Props:
- `variant`: "default" | "primary" | "subtle" | "danger" | "dangerSubtle" | "ghost" | "ghostSubtle" · default "default"
- `size`: "small" | "medium" | "large" · default "medium"
- `isPending`: boolean · default false
- `selected`: boolean · default false
- `fullWidth`: boolean · default false
- `isIconButton`: boolean · default false
- `disabled`: boolean
- `type`: "button" | "submit" | "reset" · default "button"
- `children`: ReactNode · required
Example:
```tsx
<Button variant="primary">Save workspace</Button>
```

#### SpeedDial
Import: `SpeedDial`
Use: A plus button that fans out labeled actions.
Live: /components/speed-dial
Props:
- `actions`: { label: string; onClick: () => void }[] · required
Example:
```tsx
<SpeedDial actions={[{ label: "Invite", onClick: invite }]} />
```

#### Icon
Import: `Icon`
Use: Stroke icons. Name must be an IconName.
Live: /components/icon
Props:
- `name`: IconName · required · check, x, search, info, alert, chevron, chevronLeft, chevronRight, plus, minus, copy, calendar, paperclip, file, image, more, menu, terminal, globe, message, user, settings, home, checkCircle, xCircle, upload, download, arrowUpRight, branch, spark, grip
- `size`: number · default 16
Example:
```tsx
<Icon name="check" size={16} />
```

#### Logo
Import: `Logo`
Use: CodedDesign CD sticker. Use decorative inside a named link.
Live: /components/logo
Props:
- `size`: "sm" | "md" | "lg" · default "md"
- `decorative`: boolean · default false
Example:
```tsx
<Logo size="md" />
```

#### Typography
Import: `Heading, Title, Body, Description, Detail, Code, Bullet`
Use: Fredoka for Heading/Title. Nunito for Body and the rest.
Live: /components/typography
Props:
- `Heading.size`: "xxxl" | "xxl" | "xl" | "l" | "m" | "s" · default "xl"
- `Heading.align`: "left" | "center" | "right" · default "left"
- `Heading.withoutMargins`: boolean · default false
- `Title.size`: "xl" | "l" | "m" | "s" · default "l"
- `Body.size`: "l" | "m" | "s" · default "m"
Example:
```tsx
<Heading size="xxl" withoutMargins>Docs</Heading>
<Body>Reading copy.</Body>
```

#### Sticker
Import: `Sticker`
Use: Tilted cartoon label. Text on pastel uses onPastel.
Live: /components/sticker
Props:
- `tone`: "pink" | "blue" | "yellow" | "mint" · default "pink"
- `children`: ReactNode · required
Example:
```tsx
<Sticker tone="pink">Sample</Sticker>
```

#### Link
Import: `Link`
Use: Inline text link. Do not nest buttons inside it.
Live: /components/link
Props:
- `children`: ReactNode · required
- `...anchor`: AnchorHTMLAttributes
Example:
```tsx
<Link href="/components">Components</Link>
```

### Layout

#### Stack / Inline
Import: `Stack, Inline`
Use: Stack is a column. Inline is a wrapping row.
Live: /components/stack
Props:
- `gap`: "xxs" | "xs" | "s" | "m" | "l" | "xl" · default Stack "m", Inline "s"
- `children`: ReactNode · required
Example:
```tsx
<Stack gap="l"><Heading>Title</Heading><Body>Copy</Body></Stack>
```

#### Grid / GridItem
Import: `Grid, GridItem`
Use: Equal columns. Wrap cells in GridItem.
Live: /components/grid
Props:
- `columns`: number · default 3
- `gap`: "xs" | "s" | "m" | "l" · default "m"
Example:
```tsx
<Grid columns={2}><GridItem>Left</GridItem><GridItem>Right</GridItem></Grid>
```

#### Spacer
Import: `Spacer`
Use: Empty gap using space tokens.
Live: /components/spacer
Props:
- `size`: "xxs" | "xs" | "s" | "m" | "l" | "xl" · default "m"
Example:
```tsx
<Spacer size="l" />
```

#### Divider
Aliases: Separator
Import: `Divider`
Use: Horizontal rule.
Live: /components/divider
Example:
```tsx
<Divider />
```

#### Resizable
Import: `Resizable`
Use: Two panes with a drag handle.
Live: /components/resizable
Props:
- `left`: ReactNode · required
- `right`: ReactNode · required
Example:
```tsx

```

#### ScrollArea
Import: `ScrollArea`
Use: Clipped scrolling well.
Live: /components/scroll-area
Props:
- `children`: ReactNode · required
Example:
```tsx
<ScrollArea>{longList}</ScrollArea>
```

#### AspectRatio
Import: `AspectRatio`
Use: Locks a box to a ratio.
Live: /components/aspect-ratio
Props:
- `ratio`: number · default 16 / 9
- `children`: ReactNode · required
Example:
```tsx
<AspectRatio ratio={16 / 9}><img alt="" src={src} /></AspectRatio>
```

#### Overlay
Import: `Overlay`
Use: Dimmed layer. Drawers and dialogs already include one.
Live: /components/overlay
Props:
- `onClick`: () => void
- `children`: ReactNode
Example:
```tsx
<Overlay onClick={close} />
```

### Navigation

#### Breadcrumb

Use: Path back out.

- `label`: string · default "Breadcrumb"
Example:
```tsx
<Breadcrumb items={[{ label: "Workspace", href: "/" }, { label: "Docs" }]} />
```

#### DropdownMenu
Import: `DropdownMenu`
Use: Actions from a labeled trigger.
Live: /components/dropdown
Props:
- `label`: string · required
- `items`: MenuAction[] · required · { label, onSelect?, shortcut?, destructive?, disabled?, separator? }
Example:
```tsx
<DropdownMenu label="Actions" items={[{ label: "Duplicate" }, { label: "Delete", destructive: true }]} />
```

#### Menubar
Import: `Menubar`
Use: App menu row.
Live: /components/menubar
Props:
- `menus`: { label: string; items: MenuAction[] }[] · required
Example:
```tsx
<Menubar menus={[{ label: "File", items: [{ label: "Save" }] }]} />
```

#### Pagination
Import: `Pagination`
Use: Page through a set.
Live: /components/pagination
Props:
- `page`: number · required
- `pageCount`: number · required
- `onChange`: (page: number) => void · required
- `label`: string · default "Pages"
Example:
```tsx
<Pagination page={1} pageCount={4} onChange={setPage} />
```

#### Step / SteppedHeader
Import: `Step, SteppedHeader`
Use: Progress through a sequence.
Live: /components/steps
Props:
- `Step.number`: number · required
- `Step.label`: string · required
- `Step.active`: boolean · default false
- `Step.complete`: boolean · default false
- `Step.isBlocked`: boolean · default false
- `SteppedHeader.steps`: { label: string }[] · required
- `SteppedHeader.current`: number · required
Example:
```tsx
<SteppedHeader steps={[{ label: "Details" }, { label: "Review" }]} current={0} />
```

#### Tabs
Import: `Tabs, TabList, Tab, TabPanel`
Use: Switch panels. Set defaultValue or value.
Live: /components/tabs
Props:
- `Tabs.defaultValue`: string
- `Tabs.value`: string
- `Tabs.onValueChange`: (value: string) => void
- `Tab.value`: string · required
- `TabPanel.value`: string · required
Example:
```tsx
<Tabs defaultValue="account">
  <TabList><Tab value="account">Account</Tab></TabList>
  <TabPanel value="account">Profile</TabPanel>
</Tabs>
```

#### NavigationMenu
Import: `NavigationMenu`
Use: Site nav with optional flyout links.
Live: /components/nav
Props:
- `items`: { label: string; href?: string; links?: { title: string; href: string; hint?: string }[] }[] · required
Example:
```tsx
<NavigationMenu items={[{ label: "Overview", href: "/" }]} />
```

#### AppSidebar
Aliases: Sidebar
Import: `AppSidebar`
Use: Product nav with home, message, settings, or user icons.
Live: /components/sidebar
Props:
- `items`: { label: string; icon: "home" | "message" | "settings" | "user"; href?: string }[] · required
Example:
```tsx
<AppSidebar items={[{ label: "Home", icon: "home" }]} />
```

#### OverflowPopover
Import: `OverflowPopover`
Use: Park extra actions behind More.
Live: /components/overflow
Props:
- `label`: string · default "More"
- `children`: ReactNode · required
Example:
```tsx
<OverflowPopover><Button>Archive</Button></OverflowPopover>
```

### Data entry

#### TextField / TextArea
Import: `TextField, TextArea`
Use: Labeled inputs. Error string marks invalid.
Live: /components/text-field
Props:
- `label`: string · required
- `hint`: string
- `error`: string
- `value`: string
- `defaultValue`: string
- `onChange`: (value: string) => void
- `TextField.type`: "text" | "email" | "password" | "url" | "tel" · default "text"
- `TextField.canReveal`: boolean · default false · password eye
- `TextArea.rows`: number · default 4
Example:
```tsx
<TextField label="Work email" type="email" />
```

#### Select
Aliases: NativeSelect
Import: `Select`
Use: Native labeled select.
Live: /components/select
Props:
- `label`: string
- `options`: { label: string; value: string }[] · required
- `value`: string
- `onChange`: (value: string) => void
Example:
```tsx
<Select label="Plan" options={[{ label: "Pro", value: "pro" }]} />
```

#### Checkbox

#### Switch

#### Toggle / ToggleButton
Aliases: ToggleGroup
Import: `Toggle, ToggleButton`
Use: Toggle is one pressed control. ToggleButton is a labeled group.
Live: /components/toggle
Props:

- `Toggle.onPressedChange`: (pressed: boolean) => void · required
- `ToggleButton.options`: { label: string; value: string }[] · required

```tsx

```

#### Attachment
Import: `Attachment, AttachmentGroup`
Use: File chip with upload states.
Live: /components/attachment
Props:
- `name`: string · required
- `meta`: string · required
- `state`: "idle" | "uploading" | "processing" | "error" | "done" · default "done"

- `preview`: string

Example:
```tsx

```

#### Form
Import: `Form, FormRow, FormActions`
Use: Card form. title is required. onSubmit is already preventDefaulted.
Live: /components/form
Props:
- `title`: string · required
- `description`: string
- `onSubmit`: (event: FormEvent) => void
- `children`: ReactNode · required
Example:
```tsx
<Form title="Sign in"><TextField label="Work email" /><FormActions><Button variant="primary">Sign in</Button></FormActions></Form>
```

#### Field / Label / SearchInput / LanguageSelect
Import: `Field, Label, SearchInput, LanguageSelect`
Use: Field wraps a control with a label. SearchInput is a fluid controlled search box. LanguageSelect is a preset locale list.
Live: /components/field
Props:
- `Field.label`: string · required
- `SearchInput.value`: string · required
- `SearchInput.onChange`: (value: string) => void · required
- `SearchInput.label`: string · default "Search"
- `SearchInput.hideLabel`: boolean · default false · Keeps the accessible name. Use in rails and toolbars.
- `SearchInput.shape`: "default" | "pill" · default "default"
- `SearchInput.placeholder`: string · default "Search"
Example:
```tsx
<SearchInput label="Find a component" hideLabel shape="pill" value={q} onChange={setQ} />
```

#### Item
Import: `Item, ItemGroup`
Use: Row in a list: media, title, description, actions.
Live: /components/item
Props:
- `title`: string · required
- `description`: string
- `media`: ReactNode
- `actions`: ReactNode
- `last`: boolean · default false
Example:
```tsx
<Item title="Ada Lovelace" description="Designer" media={<Avatar name="Ada Lovelace" />} />
```

#### CodeBlock
Import: `CodeBlock`
Use: Copyable snippet. language is a label.
Live: /components/code-block
Props:
- `code`: string · required
- `language`: string · default "tsx"
Example:
```tsx
<CodeBlock code={install} language="bash" />
```

#### SpeechBubble
Aliases: Bubble
Import: `SpeechBubble`
Use: Cartoon callout. Not for chat — use Message.
Live: /components/speech-bubble
Props:
- `tone`: "cream" | "pink" | "blue" · default "cream"
- `children`: ReactNode · required
Example:
```tsx
<SpeechBubble tone="pink">Keep poking.</SpeechBubble>
```

#### EmptyState
Aliases: Empty

Use: Nothing to show yet.
Live: /components/empty
Props:
- `title`: string · required
- `description`: string
- `action`: ReactNode
Example:
```tsx
<EmptyState title="Nothing matches" description="Try another filter." />
```

#### Marker
Import: `Marker`
Use: Inline glyph + label.
Live: /components/marker
Props:
- `variant`: "default" | "border" | "separator" · default "default"
- `icon`: IconName
- `children`: ReactNode · required
Example:
```tsx
<Marker icon="check">Ready</Marker>
```

#### Chart labels
Import: `ChartLegend, ChartTooltip, ChartAxisLabel`
Use: Legend/tooltip/axis for a chart you draw yourself. Colors: blue, green, pink, turquoise, warning.
Live: /components/chart
Props:
- `ChartLegend.items`: { label: string; color: ChartColor }[] · required
- `ChartTooltip.label`: string · required
- `ChartTooltip.value`: string · required
Example:
```tsx
<ChartLegend items={[{ label: "Saved", color: "blue" }]} />
```

#### AlertDialog
Import: `AlertDialog`
Use: Confirm a destructive action.
Live: /components/alert-dialog
Props:
- `open`: boolean · required
- `title`: string · required
- `onCancel`: () => void · required
- `onAction`: () => void · required
- `actionLabel`: string · default "Continue"
- `cancelLabel`: string · default "Cancel"
- `destructive`: boolean · default false
Example:
```tsx
<AlertDialog open={open} title="Archive workspace?" destructive onCancel={close} onAction={archive} />
```

#### LoadingDialog
Import: `LoadingDialog`
Use: Blocking wait.

- `open`: boolean · required
- `message`: string · default "Working…"
- `onClose`: () => void · required
Example:
```tsx
<LoadingDialog open={busy} onClose={close} />
```

#### Toast
Aliases: Notification
Import: `ToastProvider, useToast`
Use: Wrap the app in ToastProvider. Call useToast() to push.
Live: /components/toast
Props:
- `useToast()`: (toast: { type: "info" | "success" | "warning" | "error"; message: string }) => void
Example:
```tsx
const push = useToast();
push({ type: "success", message: "Workspace saved" });
```

#### Message
Import: `Message, MessageScroller`

- `children`: ReactNode · required
Example:
```tsx

</MessageScroller>
```

### Other

#### Command

- `open`: boolean · required

- `onSelect`: (value: string) => void · required
Example:
```tsx
<Command open={open} items={[{ label: "Docs", value: "docs" }]} onClose={close} onSelect={run} />
```

#### FaqSection
Import: `FaqSection`
Use: Docs FAQ. Pass items or a single question/answer.
Live: /components/faq
Props:
- `items`: { question: string; answer: string }[]
- `question`: string
- `answer`: string
Example:
```tsx
<FaqSection items={[{ question: "How do I theme?", answer: "darkTheme from the theme export." }]} />
```

#### Questionnaire
Import: `Questionnaire`
Use: Stepped choices.
Live: /components/questionnaire
Props:
- `items`: { name: string; prompt: string; description?: string; required?: boolean; choices: { value: string; label: string; hint?: string }[] }[] · required
- `onComplete`: (answers: Record<string, string>) => void
Example:
```tsx
<Questionnaire items={[{ name: "next", prompt: "What next?", choices: [{ value: "a", label: "Delegation" }] }]} />
```

#### Trace
Import: `Trace, TraceLine`
Use: Agent or build log.
Live: /components/trace
Props:
- `TraceLine.icon`: IconName · default "terminal"
- `TraceLine.title`: string · required
- `TraceLine.description`: string
- `TraceLine.status`: "running" | "error" | "pending"
- `TraceLine.detail`: string
Example:
```tsx
<Trace><TraceLine title="Searched" description="pnpm build" /></Trace>
```

#### Shortcut
Aliases: Kbd
Import: `Shortcut`
Use: Key combo chip.

- `keys`: string[] · required
Example:
```tsx

```

#### GenericFilter
Import: `GenericFilter`
Use: Search plus status filter for tables.
Live: /components/filter
Props:
- `query`: string · required
- `onQueryChange`: (value: string) => void · required
- `status`: string
- `onStatusChange`: (value: string) => void
- `statusOptions`: { label: string; value: string }[]
Example:
```tsx
<GenericFilter query={q} onQueryChange={setQ} />
```

## Do not

- Gradient text, emoji-as-icons, zero-blur hard offset shadows unless already in a component.
- Restyle tokens to a generic SaaS look.
- Add @stylexjs/babel-plugin to the consuming app just to use a Button.
- Nest Card, Form, or MessageScroller inside another card surface.
